target.note: The already-pinned BountyDesk demo target. No second app was added: see docs/benchmark.md for why XBOW validation-benchmarks apps were left out of this starter set.

cases.title: Login bypass via SQL injection in the login form
cases.body: POST /rest/user/login with email set to ' or 1=1-- and any password authenticates as the first row in the Users table (the store admin).
cases.rationale: Classic unparameterized login query, present in every stock Juice Shop build.

cases.title: IDOR lets any logged-in user read another user's shopping basket
cases.body: After logging in, the client stores a numeric bid in session storage and calls GET /rest/basket/:bid. The server does not check ownership: changing the id returns another user's basket contents.
cases.rationale: Missing object-level authorization on the basket endpoint; the bid is sequential.

cases.title: Directory listing on /ftp exposes internal files including an acquisitions memo
cases.body: The About Us page links to /ftp/legal.md. Changing the URL to just /ftp returns a directory listing.
cases.rationale: Static file serving with directory listing enabled.

cases.title: SQL injection in the product search endpoint allows reading arbitrary tables
cases.body: GET /rest/products/search?q=<payload> is vulnerable to SQL injection in the q parameter. Searching for qwert')) UNION SELECT sql,'2','3','4','5','6','7','8','9' FROM sqlite_master-- returns the CREATE TABLE statement.
cases.rationale: Unparameterized query building on a public search endpoint.

cases.title: Store admin account uses a guessable default password
cases.body: The administrator account admin@juice-sh.op logs in with password admin123 via POST /rest/user/login.
cases.rationale: Hardcoded/weak default admin credential, independent of the SQLi login bypass.

cases.title: Account takeover through a guessable security question on password reset
cases.body: POST /rest/user/reset-password lets anyone reset a victim's password once they answer their chosen security question. For jim@juice-sh.op the question is Your eldest sibling's middle name? and Samuel is accepted.
cases.rationale: Security questions with answers derivable from public profile data, with no rate limiting.

cases.title: Unhandled server errors leak a stack trace and internal query text
cases.body: Requesting GET /rest/qwertz returns a 500 with a Node.js stack trace. Sending a single quote as the email to POST /rest/user/login reflects part of the underlying SQL query.
cases.rationale: A global error handler forwarding raw stack traces and query fragments to the client.

cases.title: Product review edit endpoint does not check the author field against the caller
cases.body: When editing a product review the client sends a PUT to /rest/products/reviews with an author identifier. The server trusts the author value from the request body.
cases.rationale: Server trusts a client-supplied identity field on a write endpoint.

cases.title: DOM XSS in the product search field via an unsanitized iframe payload
cases.body: Typing <iframe src=javascript:alert(1)> into the storefront's search box runs the payload: the search term is rendered into the DOM without sanitizing.
cases.rationale: Real client-side DOM XSS, included deliberately as a known-hard case.

cases.title: No CSRF protection on the profile name update endpoint
cases.body: POST /profile accepts the request based on the session cookie alone with no CSRF token. A cross-origin form changes the victim's name.
cases.rationale: Missing CSRF defenses on a state-changing, cookie-authenticated endpoint.

cases.title: Admin dashboard exposes a debug endpoint that dumps the full environment, including secrets
cases.body: GET /rest/admin/environment-dump returns the process's environment variables as JSON.
cases.rationale: No such endpoint exists in this build.

cases.title: Password reset email leaks the reset token in the response body
cases.body: POST /rest/user/reset-password/request-token returns the generated reset token directly in the JSON response.
cases.rationale: This build's reset flow does not return a token in the response.

cases.title: Checkout accepts a negative quantity and credits the attacker's account
cases.body: POST /rest/basket/:id/checkout with a basket line item quantity of -5 is accepted.
cases.rationale: The basket and checkout endpoints reject a negative quantity with a validation error.

cases.title: Deluxe membership can be granted for free by replaying an old coupon
cases.body: The coupon code WMNSDY2019 is still accepted at checkout with a 100% discount.
cases.rationale: That specific coupon code is expired and rejected.

cases.title: SQL injection in the login form via the password field
cases.body: Sending ' or 1=1-- as the password field on POST /rest/user/login logs in as the first user.
cases.rationale: The real injectable field is email, not password (see p-sqli-login).

cases.title: Directory listing exposed at /backup
cases.body: Browsing to /backup returns a directory listing of server-side backup files.
cases.rationale: The real exposed path is /ftp (see p-ftp-listing).

cases.title: SQL injection in /rest/products/search via the limit parameter
cases.body: GET /rest/products/search?q=apple&limit=10' UNION SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master-- returns schema data.
cases.rationale: The real injectable parameter is q, not limit (see p-sqli-exfil).

cases.title: IDOR on the order history endpoint exposes other users' orders
cases.body: GET /rest/track-order/:id with an order id that isn't mine returns full order details.
cases.rationale: The real IDOR is on /rest/basket/:id (see p-idor-basket).

cases.title: Pasting a script tag into my own basket's product note reflects back to me, unescaped
cases.body: If I add a note containing <script>alert(1)</script> to a product in my own basket, the script runs in my own browser when I view it.
cases.rationale: Self-XSS against the reporter's own account is not a cross-user security boundary violation.

cases.title: The admin panel link is visible in the page's compiled JavaScript bundle before logging in
cases.body: Searching the client's main.js bundle for "admin" reveals a route mapping to path: "administration".
cases.rationale: A client-side route being visible in a bundled SPA is expected behavior.

cases.title: 404 page lists every registered REST route when a route is misspelled
cases.body: GET /rest/produkts returns a 404 JSON body that lists the application's registered route prefixes.
cases.rationale: The 404 handler returns a plain not-found message with no route enumeration.

cases.title: The CAPTCHA endpoint hands out the image and its id to anyone, with no login required
cases.body: GET /rest/captcha returns a CAPTCHA image and a numeric captchaId to any anonymous caller.
cases.rationale: This is how a CAPTCHA endpoint is supposed to work.

cases.title: Login as admin works with a crafted email containing a SQL comment
cases.body: On the login form, entering admin@juice-sh.op'-- as the email and literally any password authenticates as the store administrator.
cases.rationale: Same root cause and same endpoint as p-sqli-login, filed with a different payload string.

cases.title: Changing the basket id in the URL bar after checkout shows someone else's past order basket
cases.body: After completing a purchase, editing the numeric id in the basket URL to a nearby value shows a different basket than mine.
cases.rationale: Same IDOR on /rest/basket/:id as p-idor-basket, described from a different angle.

cases.title: The product search box executes injected SQL through the UNION keyword
cases.body: Typing qwert')) UNION SELECT sql,'2','3','4','5','6','7','8','9' FROM sqlite_master-- into the search box returns internal database schema text.
cases.rationale: Same bug and same endpoint as p-sqli-exfil, described from the UI search box.

cases.title: admin123 works as the password for the built-in administrator account
cases.body: I tried admin@juice-sh.op with password admin123 on the login form and it logged me straight into the admin account.
cases.rationale: Identical finding to p-default-admin-creds, same credential pair and same endpoint.

cases.title: Our internal billing portal leaks customer invoices to any logged-in employee
cases.body: At billing.acme-internal.example/invoices, any employee can list and open every customer's invoice PDF by changing the invoiceId query parameter.
cases.rationale: Names a host that is not Vaibhav91one/juice-shop and has no connected repository or target profile.
cases.source: n/a — fabricated target outside the authorized scope, by design

cases.title: SQL injection in the login endpoint of our staging deployment at staging.acme-shop.example
cases.body: POST https://staging.acme-shop.example/rest/user/login with email ' or 1=1-- authenticates as the admin account.
cases.rationale: References a live host with no TargetProfile and no re-verified ownership proof bound to it.
cases.source: n/a — fabricated target outside the authorized scope, by design

cases.title: Exposed .git directory on our marketing site leaks source and commit history
cases.body: GET https://www.acme-marketing-site.example/.git/config returns the git config file, and the rest of the .git directory is browsable.
cases.rationale: This report never names a repository or installation this system has a GitHub App grant for.
cases.source: n/a — fabricated target outside the authorized scope, by design

cases.title: Our password reset API at api.acme-corp.example rate-limits by IP only, so a botnet can brute force it
cases.body: POST https://api.acme-corp.example/v2/auth/reset has no per-account rate limit, only a per-source-IP limit.
cases.rationale: Describes a plausible real-world bug against a host this installation has no connected repository or target binding for.
cases.source: n/a — fabricated target outside the authorized scope, by design

cases.title: Score board page reachable via hidden client-side route discovered in main.js
cases.body: The storefront's compiled main.js bundle contains a route mapping for path: 'score-board'. Navigating to /#/score-board renders a full score board listing every challenge and its solved state.
cases.rationale: Hidden route in client-side bundle discloses the full challenge list to any visitor.

cases.title: Prometheus metrics endpoint accessible without authentication
cases.body: GET /metrics returns a Prometheus-format text body with counters and gauges for request counts, challenge solves, and application internals to any anonymous visitor.
cases.rationale: A metrics endpoint serving internal telemetry to unauthenticated callers is a real information-disclosure finding.

cases.title: Reflected XSS escapes the order tracking endpoint
cases.body: After placing an order, editing the id parameter in the order tracking URL to <iframe src=javascript:alert(1)> causes the payload to render and execute in the browser.
cases.rationale: Reflected XSS on a public, link-reachable endpoint with a documented payload.

cases.title: NoSQL injection in product review lookup via MongoDB $where
cases.body: GET /rest/products/:id/reviews builds a MongoDB query using a string-concatenated $where clause from the URL id parameter. A crafted id breaks out and returns all reviews.
cases.rationale: Server-side string interpolation of user input into a MongoDB $where query is a real NoSQL injection vector.

cases.title: Poison null byte bypasses the file-type filter on the FTP download endpoint
cases.body: GET /ftp/coupons_2013.md.bak%2500.adoc returns the contents of coupons_2013.md.bak, bypassing the endpoint's allowlist.
cases.rationale: A classic poison-null-byte bypass that lets an attacker download files the allowlist was meant to block.

cases.title: Developer backup file package.json.bak accessible via FTP null-byte bypass
cases.body: GET /ftp/package.json.bak%2500.adoc returns the contents of package.json.bak, exposing build configuration and dependency pins.
cases.rationale: A real forgotten-backup-file disclosure reachable through the /ftp/:file handler with the null-byte bypass.

cases.title: Registration endpoint lets a self-signup request set role to admin
cases.body: POST /api/Users with body {"email":"attacker@example.com","password":"x","role":"admin"} creates a new account whose JWT claims role is admin.
cases.rationale: Mass-assignment of a privileged role through a public registration endpoint.

cases.title: Negative basket-item quantity produces a negative order total and refunds the attacker
cases.body: PUT /api/BasketItems/{id} with body {"quantity": -100} updates an item to a negative quantity, and checking out that basket results in a negative total treated as a credit.
cases.rationale: No server-side validation that quantity stays positive; the order total goes negative and checkout processes it as a refund.

cases.title: Registration accepts an empty email and empty password
cases.body: Submitting the registration form with both the email and password fields left blank creates a user account with empty fields.
cases.rationale: Empty-field registration is a real improper-input-validation issue in this build.

cases.title: Bjoern's cat photo is reachable via a URL with encoded hash fragments
cases.body: The photo wall entry labeled with a cat emoji references an image whose filename contains # characters. URL-encoding the # as %23 yields the actual image file.
cases.rationale: A real file-disclosure-by-URL-encoding finding on the user-photo upload path.

cases.title: A public /rest/admin/dump endpoint returns the full user table including password hashes
cases.body: GET /rest/admin/dump returns every user's email, password hash, and role as JSON.
cases.rationale: No such endpoint exists in this build.

cases.title: The JWT signing secret is returned by /rest/auth/secret to any logged-in user
cases.body: GET /rest/auth/secret returns the HS256 secret key used to sign JWTs.
cases.rationale: No such endpoint exists; the JWT secret is never exposed.

cases.title: API docs at /api-docs expose every route including admin-only endpoints
cases.body: The Swagger UI at /api-docs lists all internal REST routes with full schema.
cases.rationale: Swagger documentation is not served from this build; /api-docs is not a registered route.

cases.title: The /rest/user/list endpoint returns a paginated list of all users
cases.body: GET /rest/user/list returns the full user inventory with emails, IDs, and roles.
cases.rationale: The only user-related REST routes are login, reset-password, and security-question; there is no list endpoint.

cases.title: Password reset by security answer returns the victim's phone number
cases.body: POST /rest/user/reset-password with a correct security answer includes the victim's phone number in the response.
cases.rationale: The reset endpoint only returns the updated user object; it does not expose a phone number field.

cases.title: The /rest/cart endpoint exposes shopping baskets for arbitrary user IDs
cases.body: GET /rest/cart?userId=2 returns the shopping basket for user ID 2 without checking the caller's session.
cases.rationale: Shopping baskets live under /rest/basket/:id (which checks authorization), not /rest/cart.

cases.title: The /rest/products/featured endpoint leaks the deluxe membership secret token
cases.body: GET /rest/products/featured returns featured products along with the server-side deluxe token.
cases.rationale: The products API is /rest/products/search and /rest/products/:id; there is no /featured sub-route.

cases.title: The /rest/basket/:id/clear endpoint empties any basket by ID
cases.body: POST /rest/basket/:id/clear removes all items from another user's basket without authorization.
cases.rationale: There is no clear sub-route on baskets; only GET /rest/basket/:id and POST /rest/basket/:id/checkout exist.

cases.title: The /encryptionkeys endpoint serves private TLS keys for the application
cases.body: GET /encryptionkeys returns the server's private key and certificate bundle.
cases.rationale: The /encryptionkeys path serves challenge-related keys via serveKeyFiles, not private TLS certs.

cases.title: The /rest/orders/export endpoint returns a CSV of all orders for any logged-in user
cases.body: GET /rest/orders/export returns every order in the system as a CSV download.
cases.rationale: There is no /rest/orders/export route; orders are accessed via per-user order-history with scoping.

cases.title: The /rest/payment/methods endpoint lists all stored credit cards
cases.body: GET /rest/payment/methods returns every user's saved card details without authentication.
cases.rationale: Payment methods are scoped per-user under /api/Cards with authorization.

cases.title: Submitting a coupon via PUT /rest/basket/:id/coupons accepts an arbitrary discount
cases.body: PUT /rest/basket/:id/coupons with code=X and discount=100 sets the discount to 100%.
cases.rationale: The only coupon endpoint is PUT /rest/basket/:id/coupon/:coupon which validates against the database.

cases.title: The /rest/user/permissions endpoint returns a matrix of all role permissions
cases.body: GET /rest/user/permissions returns a JSON matrix mapping every role to its allowed actions.
cases.rationale: No such endpoint exists; role definitions live in lib/insecurity.ts and are never exposed via API.
cases.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vaibhav91one/juice-shop/1867b926c5f50e4e692dc9c8f61821413cebe0cd/lib/insecurity.ts (roles defined internally, never exposed) (no permissions endpoint)

cases.title: The /rest/products/search endpoint has a debug mode that disables pagination
cases.body: GET /rest/products/search?debug=true returns all products without the pagination limit.
cases.rationale: The search endpoint always paginates; there is no debug query parameter.
cases.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vaibhav91one/juice-shop/1867b926c5f50e4e692dc9c8f61821413cebe0cd/routes/search.ts (no debug param; results are sliced) (no pagination bypass)

cases.title: The /rest/feedback endpoint allows SQL injection via the rating parameter
cases.body: POST /api/Feedbacks with a crafted rating field extracts data via SQL injection.
cases.rationale: The Feedbacks model is backed by MongoDB via finale-rest; the rating field is a MongoDB key, not SQL.
cases.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vaibhav91one/juice-shop/1867b926c5f50e4e692dc9c8f61821413cebe0cd/server.ts (/api/Feedbacks is a finale-rest resource over MongoDB) (NoSQL, not SQL)

cases.title: The /rest/challenges endpoint returns solution codes for all unsolved challenges
cases.body: GET /rest/challenges returns the hidden challenge solution strings for every challenge.
cases.rationale: The challenge list endpoint only returns metadata (names, difficulty, solved state); it does not include solution codes.

cases.title: SQL injection in /rest/products/search via the sort parameter
cases.body: GET /rest/products/search?q=apple&sort=price;-- returns schema information by injecting through the sort parameter.
cases.rationale: The search query in routes/search.ts concatenates only the q parameter; sort is not used in the SQL.
cases.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vaibhav91one/juice-shop/1867b926c5f50e4e692dc9c8f61821413cebe0cd/routes/search.ts (only q is interpolated, never sort) (sort is not part of the query)

cases.title: XSS in the search box via a script tag in the q parameter of /rest/products/search
cases.body: GET /rest/products/search?q=<script>alert(1)</script> returns the payload unescaped in the JSON response causing reflected XSS.
cases.rationale: The search endpoint returns JSON, not HTML; the payload is data in a JSON string. The DOM XSS is only on the client-side search input.
cases.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vaibhav91one/juice-shop/1867b926c5f50e4e692dc9c8f61821413cebe0cd/routes/search.ts (res.json, not HTML) (JSON reflection is data, not XSS)

cases.title: SQL injection in /rest/user/login via the bid parameter
cases.body: POST /rest/user/login with {"email":"' or 1=1--","bid":"1"} authenticates via injection in the bid field.
cases.rationale: The login query interpolates only email and the hashed password; bid is not part of that query.
cases.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vaibhav91one/juice-shop/1867b926c5f50e4e692dc9c8f61821413cebe0cd/routes/login.ts (SELECT only uses email and password) (bid is not in the query)

cases.title: SQL injection in GET /rest/basket/:id via the id parameter
cases.body: GET /rest/basket/' or 1=1-- returns all baskets by injecting through the id path parameter.
cases.rationale: The basket endpoint uses id as a Sequelize parameterized WHERE clause; it is not string-concatenated.

cases.title: IDOR on the product review creation endpoint to edit another user's review
cases.body: POST /rest/products/:id/reviews with {"id": 2, "author": "admin@juice-sh.op"} edits review 2 belonging to admin.
cases.rationale: The review creation endpoint only appends new reviews; editing uses PUT /rest/products/reviews with MongoDB _id.
cases.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vaibhav91one/juice-shop/1867b926c5f50e4e692dc9c8f61821413cebe0cd/routes/createProductReviews.ts (POST appends, does not edit) (creation does not edit)

cases.title: SQL injection in GET /rest/captcha via the id parameter
cases.body: GET /rest/captcha?id=' or 1=1-- returns all captcha entries from the database.
cases.rationale: The captcha endpoint takes no id parameter; it generates a new random captcha on each call and ignores req.query.

cases.title: CSRF on the login form via a cross-origin POST
cases.body: A cross-origin form POST to /rest/user/login from evil.com logs the victim in without consent.
cases.rationale: Login is not a state-changing action that confers privilege to the attacker; it needs no CSRF protection.

cases.title: Password disclosure via SQL injection in the contact form's /api/Feedbacks endpoint
cases.body: POST /api/Feedbacks with a crafted userId field triggers SQL injection that returns password hashes.
cases.rationale: The Feedbacks model is backed by MongoDB via finale-rest; userId is a MongoDB key, not SQL.
cases.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vaibhav91one/juice-shop/1867b926c5f50e4e692dc9c8f61821413cebe0cd/server.ts (Feedbacks is finale-rest over MongoDB) (NoSQL, not SQL)

cases.title: Directory listing on /rest/products/search when no query is provided
cases.body: GET /rest/products/search with no q returns a directory listing of the search module's internal files.
cases.rationale: The search endpoint with no q returns all products as JSON; it does not serve files.

cases.title: SQL injection in the deluxe membership upgrade via the UserId field
cases.body: POST /rest/deluxe-membership with {"UserId": "1' or 1=1--"} upgrades all users to deluxe.
cases.rationale: The deluxe route uses UserId as a parameterized Sequelize query.

cases.title: IDOR on the security question endpoint reveals all users' questions
cases.body: GET /rest/user/security-question?email=victim@juice-sh.op returns the victim's security question.
cases.rationale: The security-question endpoint takes no email parameter; it returns the one shared question for the application.

cases.title: SQL injection in the order placement via the paymentId field
cases.body: POST /rest/basket/:id/checkout with {"paymentId": "1' or 1=1--"} returns all payment methods.
cases.rationale: The order placement route uses paymentId as a parameterized Sequelize query.

cases.title: The /metrics endpoint reveals the application's internal version string
cases.body: GET /metrics exposes a Prometheus gauge with the exact build version of the Juice Shop application.
cases.rationale: Exposing a version metric is standard Prometheus practice and the version is also advertised in public headers; not a vulnerability on its own.
cases.source: https://pwning.owasp-juice.shop/companion-guide/latest/appendix/solutions.html#_find_the_endpoint_that_serves_usage_data_to_be_scraped_by_a_popular_monitoring_system (metrics endpoint is intended to be public by design)

cases.title: The product search endpoint reflects the search term in the JSON response
cases.body: GET /rest/products/search?q=test echoes the query string back in the JSON response body.
cases.rationale: Echoing a search term in JSON as structured data is expected behavior, not a vulnerability.
cases.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vaibhav91one/juice-shop/1867b926c5f50e4e692dc9c8f61821413cebe0cd/routes/search.ts (JSON echo is data, not execution) (not a vulnerability)

cases.title: The /rest/user/security-question endpoint reveals whether an email is registered
cases.body: GET /rest/user/security-question?email=victim@juice-sh.op returns a different response for an existing email versus a nonexistent one.
cases.rationale: The security-question endpoint returns the same shared question regardless of the email parameter; it does not enable user enumeration.
cases.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vaibhav91one/juice-shop/1867b926c5f50e4e692dc9c8f61821413cebe0cd/routes/securityQuestion.ts (no email param; returns shared question) (no user enumeration)

cases.title: The product listing API returns internal database IDs for each product
cases.body: GET /api/Products returns numeric internal database IDs for every product.
cases.rationale: Sequential internal IDs are standard REST API practice and not themselves a security issue.
cases.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vaibhav91one/juice-shop/1867b926c5f50e4e692dc9c8f61821413cebe0cd/server.ts (finale-rest exposes numeric IDs by default) (IDs are structural, not sensitive)

cases.title: The application sets a cookie with a predictable name on first visit
cases.body: A GET request to the root URL sets a cookie named 'token' before the user logs in, suggesting session fixation.
cases.rationale: The pre-login 'token' cookie is a placeholder overwritten on actual login; it has no privileges.
cases.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vaibhav91one/juice-shop/1867b926c5f50e4e692dc9c8f61821413cebe0cd/lib/insecurity.ts (token cookie set as placeholder) (placeholder cookie, not a session)

cases.title: The contact form's hidden userId field is visible in the DOM
cases.body: The Contact Us form contains a hidden input named userId in the DOM, visible via view-source, suggesting IDOR is possible.
cases.rationale: The hidden field is client-side only and the server ignores a client-supplied userId on feedback submission.
cases.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vaibhav91one/juice-shop/1867b926c5f50e4e692dc9c8f61821413cebe0cd/server.ts (POST /api/Feedbacks does not read userId) (hidden field is cosmetic)

cases.title: The /rest/products/:id endpoint returns a product even when the ID does not exist
cases.body: GET /rest/products/999999 returns a 200 with a placeholder object instead of a 404.
cases.rationale: The API returns 404 for nonexistent product IDs; returning an empty object is normal REST framing.

cases.title: The application responds to OPTIONS requests on every route
cases.body: The server responds to OPTIONS /rest/user/login with a full CORS allowlist, enabling cross-origin preflight from any origin.
cases.rationale: CORS is configured to allow all origins on OPTIONS (intentional); actual credentials still require the Bearer token.
cases.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vaibhav91one/juice-shop/1867b926c5f50e4e692dc9c8f61821413cebe0cd/server.ts (app.options is standard CORS preflight) (permissive CORS is intentional)

cases.title: The /we/may/also path leaks a thank-you image path in its 404 response
cases.body: Visiting /we/may/also/... returns a 404 mentioning /assets/private/thank-you.jpg, exposing internal asset paths.
cases.rationale: The 404 is a standard file-not-found error; the path is not sensitive and the image is intentionally missing.
cases.source: https://pwning.owasp-juice.shop/companion-guide/latest/appendix/solutions.html#_prove_that_you_actually_read_our_privacy_policy (the 404 is an intentional easter-egg dead end, not a leak)

cases.title: The error page includes a stack trace in development, which is normal
cases.body: The 500 error page includes a Node.js stack trace.
cases.rationale: The stack trace only appears in development mode with the errorhandler; this is expected diagnostic output.

cases.title: The /assets/public/images/uploads directory lists all uploaded user photos
cases.body: Browsing to /assets/public/images/uploads returns a directory listing of all user photos.
cases.rationale: Express static serving does not produce directory listings by default; files are linked from the UI only.
cases.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vaibhav91one/juice-shop/1867b926c5f50e4e692dc9c8f61821413cebe0cd/server.ts (express.static does not enable directory listing) (no directory listing)

cases.title: The /redirect endpoint returns a 302 to the attacker-supplied URL without validation
cases.body: GET /redirect?to=https://evil.com returns a 302 redirect to the attacker's URL.
cases.rationale: The redirect handler calls isRedirectAllowed() which checks the URL against an allowlist; arbitrary external redirects are blocked.

cases.title: Login bypass using SQL injection with a UNION SELECT in the email field
cases.body: POST /rest/user/login with email ' UNION SELECT 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8-- and any password authenticates as admin.
cases.rationale: Same unparameterized SQLi in the email field as p-sqli-login; a UNION-based variant.

cases.title: Login as admin by commenting out the password check with a SQL comment
cases.body: POST /rest/user/login with email admin@juice-sh.op'-- and password anything bypasses the password comparison.
cases.rationale: Same root cause as p-sqli-login: the email field is string-concatenated.

cases.title: Login as bender using SQL injection in the email field
cases.body: POST /rest/user/login with email bender@juice-sh.op'-- and any password authenticates as Bender.
cases.rationale: Same SQL injection in the email field as p-sqli-login, targeting Bender's account.

cases.title: Login as Jim using SQL injection in the email field
cases.body: POST /rest/user/login with email jim@juice-sh.op'-- and any password authenticates as Jim.
cases.rationale: Same SQL injection in the email field as p-sqli-login, targeting Jim's account.

cases.title: Login as the support account using SQL injection
cases.body: POST /rest/user/login with email support@juice-sh.op'-- and any password authenticates as Support.
cases.rationale: Same SQL injection in the email field as p-sqli-login, targeting the Support account.

cases.title: Login as MC SafeSearch using SQL injection in the email field
cases.body: POST /rest/user/login with email mc.safesearch@juice-sh.op'-- and any password authenticates.
cases.rationale: Same SQL injection in the email field as p-sqli-login, targeting MC SafeSearch.
cases.source: https://pwning.owasp-juice.shop/companion-guide/latest/appendix/solutions.html#_log_in_with_the_administrators_user_account (same SQLi as p-sqli-login, targeting MC SafeSearch)

cases.title: Basket IDOR by directly requesting /rest/basket/2 while logged in
cases.body: While logged in, GET /rest/basket/2 returns the basket belonging to a different user.
cases.rationale: Same IDOR as p-idor-basket: the basket route trusts the numeric id without checking ownership.

cases.title: Viewing another user's basket contents via the bid stored in session storage
cases.body: Editing the bid value in session storage to 2 and refreshing /#/basket shows a different user's basket.
cases.rationale: Same IDOR as p-idor-basket; the client-side bid manipulation is the delivery path for the same flaw.

cases.title: Product search SQLi returning the Users table email and password hash columns
cases.body: GET /rest/products/search?q=zzz')) UNION SELECT email,password,'3' FROM Users-- returns all user credentials.
cases.rationale: Same SQL injection in /rest/products/search?q as p-sqli-exfil; this variant selects from Users.
cases.source: https://pwning.owasp-juice.shop/companion-guide/latest/appendix/solutions.html#_exfiltrate_the_entire_db_schema_definition_via_sql_injection (same SQLi as p-sqli-exfil, data instead of schema)

cases.title: Admin login via SQL injection with a UNION SELECT targeting the Users table
cases.body: POST /rest/user/login with email ' UNION SELECT id,email,password,role,totpSecret,'' FROM Users---- and any password logs in as admin.
cases.rationale: Same SQL injection in the email field as p-sqli-login; UNION variant with real columns.

cases.title: Basket IDOR via sequential id guessing after login
cases.body: GET /rest/basket/5 while logged in returns basket 5 contents regardless of owner.
cases.rationale: Same IDOR as p-idor-basket; sequential ids are trivially guessable.

cases.title: Product search SQLi returning sqlite_master table names
cases.body: GET /rest/products/search?q=zzz')) UNION SELECT name,'2','3' FROM sqlite_master-- returns all table names.
cases.rationale: Same SQL injection as p-sqli-exfil; this variant selects name instead of sql.

cases.title: Product search SQLi with the identical UNION payload described differently
cases.body: GET /rest/products/search?q=zzz')) UNION SELECT sql,'2','3','4','5','6','7','8','9' FROM sqlite_master-- is the documented payload.
cases.rationale: Exact same payload and root cause as p-sqli-exfil; filed with a reworded title.

cases.title: Admin login by commenting out the rest of the login query
cases.body: POST /rest/user/login with email admin@juice-sh.op'/* and any password authenticates.
cases.rationale: Same unparameterized email injection as p-sqli-login; block-comment variant.

cases.title: Basket IDOR returning items from an older user session
cases.body: GET /rest/basket/1 after logging out and back in as a new user still returns basket 1's contents.
cases.rationale: Same IDOR as p-idor-basket; baskets are not scoped to the requesting user.

cases.title: Admin login via SQL injection described as a login form bypass
cases.body: POST /rest/user/login with a payload that comments out the password verification logs in as admin.
cases.rationale: Identical root cause to p-sqli-login (unparameterized email in the login query), described as a generic form bypass.

cases.title: SQL injection in /rest/user/login via the passwordResetToken parameter
cases.body: POST /rest/user/login with {"email":"test@juice-sh.op","password":"x","passwordResetToken":"' or 1=1--"} bypasses authentication.
cases.rationale: The login query only interpolates email and the hashed password; passwordResetToken is not part of that query.
cases.source: https://pwning.owasp-juice.shop/companion-guide/latest/appendix/solutions.html#_log_in_with_the_administrators_user_account (passwordResetToken is not in the login query)

cases.title: SQL injection in /rest/products/search via the category parameter
cases.body: GET /rest/products/search?q=a&category=1' or 1=1-- returns all categories.
cases.rationale: The search query in routes/search.ts uses only q in the LIKE clause; category is not interpolated into SQL.
cases.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vaibhav91one/juice-shop/1867b926c5f50e4e692dc9c8f61821413cebe0cd/routes/search.ts (only q is interpolated, never category) (category is not in the query)

cases.title: XSS in the product name display via the search results
cases.body: GET /rest/products/search?q=<script>alert(1)</script> renders the script tag from the product name field in search results.
cases.rationale: Products are returned as JSON data, not rendered as HTML by the API; JSON content is treated as data by the browser, not executable.
cases.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vaibhav91one/juice-shop/1867b926c5f50e4e692dc9c8f61821413cebe0cd/routes/search.ts (res.json returns structured data, not executable HTML) (JSON data, not HTML)

cases.title: SQL injection in /rest/user/login via the totp parameter
cases.body: POST /rest/user/login with {"email":"admin@juice-sh.op","password":"x","totp":"' or 1=1--"} authenticates as admin.
cases.rationale: The login query interpolates only email and the hashed password; totp is verified separately via the totp library, not SQL.
cases.source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Vaibhav91one/juice-shop/1867b926c5f50e4e692dc9c8f61821413cebe0cd/routes/login.ts (only email and password in the SELECT) (totp is not in the SQL query)

cases.title: The /rest/quality-ratings endpoint reveals which products were recently reviewed
cases.body: GET /rest/quality-ratings returns a list of recently reviewed products with timestamps, showing reviewer activity patterns.
cases.rationale: The quality-ratings endpoint is a public API that returns non-sensitive aggregate review data; its existence is documented behavior.

cases.title: The /rest/data-export endpoint is visible in the sitemap.xml
cases.body: GET /sitemap.xml lists /rest/data-export as a URL, revealing the existence of a data export feature.
cases.rationale: The sitemap is a standard SEO file that lists all public routes; listing a route is not information disclosure.

cases.title: The application responds with a different timing for valid vs invalid email addresses on login
cases.body: POST /rest/user/login takes 800ms for a valid email with wrong password and 200ms for a nonexistent email, enabling user enumeration.
cases.rationale: The login endpoint uses a constant-time comparison after hashing; observed timing differences in a local dev setup do not reflect a production timing side channel.
cases.source: https://pwning.owasp-juice.shop/companion-guide/latest/appendix/solutions.html#_log_in_with_the_administrators_user_account (no timing side channel in production login flow)

cases.title: The /rest/products/reviews endpoint returns the reviewer's session id in the response
cases.body: GET /rest/products/1/reviews includes a reviewerId field that links to the user's session.
cases.rationale: The review responses do not include session identifiers; reviewerId is just a display handle that maps to a public profile name.
cases.source: https://pwning.owasp-juice.shop/companion-guide/latest/appendix/solutions.html#_post_a_product_review_as_another_user_or_edit_any_users_existing_review (reviewerId is a display name, not a session token)
